description: Fairgoer: Who are you running against? Me: Our current U.S. Representative. Fairgoer: Who's that? And that, Neighbors, is the conversation I hold the most with constituents of multimillionaire John Joyce. Voters don't know our current U.S. Representative because he hides from us.
